description:
Studio client for Broadcast Radio Live cloud broadcasting

BR Live Studio Client is the studio application for the Broadcast Radio Live cloud broadcasting platform, providing remote studio broadcasting with a new low-latency audio engine.
v1.5.25071 12th March 2025
New Features/Changes:
Audio Engine:
- Fixed issue where Additional Delay and Data Saver settings wouldn't apply to presenters joining mid broadcast.
